history.summary: NOT A HINDU TEMPLE — keep-or-drop decision needed. This is a CHRISTIAN (Baptist) church, not a Hindu temple. CSV TOWN ERROR: there is no documented Zotlang in Lawngtlai district. Documented Zotlangs are in Lunglei district (village, PIN 796691; the BCM Statistical Report 2023-24 lists a 'ZOTLANG, LUNGLEI PASTOR BIAL' with its own bialtu pastor; indiainfo lists 'Zotlang BCM Biakin', Lunglei) and in Aizawl ('BCM Church, Zotlang', Zotlang, Aizawl 796009, per yappe.in; the BCM pastor-transfer records place Zotlang under the Aizawl Bial). The best-supported referent is the Baptist Church of Mizoram (BCM) congregation at Zotlang, Lunglei district (22.91669, 92.75165 per geocode for Zotlang Chowk, Lunglei; village geocoordinates ~22.9111, 92.7569). The Aizawl Zotlang remains a possible alternate — the generic name is ambiguous across the two towns. Verify locally which congregation is intended.

name: Zotlang Baptist Church
town: Lunglei (CSV town 'Lawngtlai' is wrong; Zotlang is in Lunglei district)
town_description: Lunglei is the second-largest town and district headquarters of Lunglei district in south-central Mizoram. Zotlang is a locality/village of Lunglei town (PIN 796691) served by its own BCM pastor bial (pastorate). Mizoram is overwhelmingly Christian, with the Baptist Church of Mizoram headquartered in Lunglei and one of the state's largest denominations.

travel.airport: Lengpui Airport (Aizawl), the nearest airport; Lunglei is about 165 km south of Aizawl by road (verify).
travel.railway: No railway station in Lunglei; nearest railhead not reliably published (verify) — candidates include Bairabi (Mizoram) and Silchar (Assam).
travel.road: Lunglei is on the Aizawl–Lawngtlai road; buses and shared taxis run from Aizawl (verify).

visitor_information.opening_hours: Sunday services are the norm for Baptist churches; confirm service timings locally.
